Sequence: Fill fuel -> Start engine -> Lock doors -> Activate parking brake.

But maybe order matters: Usually you engage parking brake before starting engine? But it's fine.

Also ensure no other steps required like checking tires etc. Not requested.

Thus produce calls accordingly.
